monthly_alignment.window_gap_policy: reject only that candidate signal as MA_UNAVAILABLE; no imputation

strategy_comparison.candidate: Same frozen V2 evaluator; only prior-completed monthly alignment and exact signal-date KRX market_cap >= 500000000000 KRW entry gate

market_cap.authority: Local immutable KRX raw market-date partition
market_cap.identity: exact signal-date PIT ticker + standard ISU_CD + market
market_cap.missing_duplicate_zero_invalid_or_unavai: reject as MCAP_UNRESOLVED with exact cause; never substitute another date, ticker, or market

universe.eligibility: COMMON interval active on the signal date
universe.permanent_exclusions: All 182 current exact (ticker, standard ISU_CD) pairs are applied once before splitting CONTROL and candidate universes

data_loading.authority: MarketDataRepositoryV2 and local immutable exact-date KRX raw partitions; no external API
data_loading.signal_price_start: max(exact active identity PIT effective_from, adjusted source first valid date); all prior completed history required by frozen V2 and the 60-month candidate window is retained
data_loading.signal_price_end: 2026-09-01 support bound; expose and classify all raw-only tail dates, never substitute raw placeholder values as adjusted signal prices
data_loading.portfolio_price_end: 2026-09-01 support bound; request enough to audit exact marks and raw-only tails, with raw placeholders used only by the approved valuation carry path
data_loading.inside_required_pit_or_warmup_gap: record exact raw/adjusted dates and fail closed; no substitute or ad hoc exclusion

must_include: all tickers with classified non-placeholder active-PIT source anomalies

portfolio.shares: integer floor after adverse buy slippage and commission
portfolio.cash_shortage: SKIPPED_CASH_UNAVAILABLE full order; do not regenerate the fixed signal ledger
portfolio.sale_proceeds_available: next exact normal KRX trading session after sell execution

valuation.daily_nav: available cash + unsettled sale proceeds + confirmed cash receivables + held integer shares times valid exact-date adjusted close
valuation.normal_trading_day_missing_mark: whole-day NAV unresolved; no partial holding omission, zero fill, interpolation, or arbitrary carry
valuation.carry: valuation only, only for exact RepositoryV2/KRX-authorized non-trading placeholder with audit evidence
valuation.cutoff_positions: mark to valid 2026-08-31 close; no hypothetical liquidation or sell costs

official_gates.A_integrity: zero material PIT/future/identity/lifecycle/cash/overlap/hidden-cap violations; source gaps with possible signal effect remain CHECK_REQUIRED
official_gates.B_costs: 100% of filled sides include 0.015% commission and 0.1% adverse slippage; transaction tax excluded
official_gates.C_profitability: total_return > 0 and CAGR > 0 for each group
official_gates.D_mdd: both P2-2 MDD >= -40%; candidate fails if CONTROL MDD - candidate MDD >= +5.0 percentage points
